title: Checkpoint validation must succeed from a detached checkout of the checkpoint tag
symptom: The documented second-tool procedure checked out the checkpoint tag and then validated, which reported CHECKPOINT_INVALID with a branch mismatch even though the commit was correct.
rootCauseSummary: Validation compared the branch name unconditionally, and a tag checkout produces a detached HEAD, so the branch control rejected the very procedure the handoff prescribed.
resolution: Detached validation is accepted only when the worktree is clean, the recorded commit is the checkpoint's canonical tag, that tag exists, and it resolves to the checked-out commit.

prevention.description: A clean detached checkout at the checkpoint tag validates.
A detached checkout at any other commit is refused.
The git binding branches on attached and detached checkouts.

applicability.requiredCheck: Validate the checkpoint from a clean clone detached at its own tag, not only on the branch.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A recorded validate_checkpoint.py run from a detached checkout returning CHECKPOINT_VALID.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

title: A file inventory must be recomputed from the repository, never trusted as an assertion
symptom: Removing an entry from FILES.json, or silently altering a tracked file, still returned CHECKPOINT_VALID for a delta checkpoint.
rootCauseSummary: The completeness and hash controls ran only when the base commit was UNBORN, so a delta checkpoint's manifest was an unverified human claim.
resolution: The change set between the base commit and the validated tree is recomputed from Git and compared to the manifest exactly, with hashAfter on added and modified paths and hashBefore on modified and deleted paths.

prevention.description: A manifest that omits a changed path is rejected.
A tracked file altered without declaration is rejected.
_validate_delta_inventory compares the manifest against the real change set.

applicability.requiredCheck: Declare every changed path with a reason before finalizing and let the tooling bind the hashes.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A FILES.json whose declared change set matches the recomputed one, proven by a passing validation.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

title: Every operation attempt must be auditable, including a refusal decided before execution

source.finding: R3 (SETUP-00-CP-0004 review, decomposed as R3.1 in SETUP-00-CP-0005) and RT-02

symptom: Finalization refused for a detached HEAD returned exit 2 while the command ledger stayed at the same number of records, so the attempt disappeared.
rootCauseSummary: The tool returned before reaching the code that records an attempt, so an entire class of attempts left no trace while the protocol claimed every attempt was recorded.
resolution: Preconditions are evaluated first and the attempt is appended before the error is returned, with the evaluated preconditions, a canonical PRECONDITION_REJECTED result, a documented result code and a failure reason, and no fabricated exit code.

prevention.description: A detached-HEAD refusal is appended to the ledger.
A refusal for a checkpoint that is not LATEST is appended.
_record_attempt runs on every path, including precondition refusals.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that a refused operation appends its attempt to the ledger before returning an error.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A ledger record with result PRECONDITION_REJECTED, a result code and a failure reason.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

title: A checkpoint may never claim readiness while it also claims to be blocked
symptom: A fully resealed checkpoint with status READY_FOR_REVIEW and a non-empty blockedBy returned CHECKPOINT_VALID.
rootCauseSummary: The blocker list was inspected only for GATE_PASS, so every other readiness status could contradict itself without detection.
resolution: READY_FOR_REVIEW, READY_FOR_RED_TEAM and GATE_PASS require an empty blockedBy in every schema version, and BLOCKED requires a stated blocker.

prevention.description: Readiness with a blocker is refused.
The escaped attack is refused end to end by the finalizer and the validator.
Status and blocker consistency is a universal invariant, not a per-version rule.

applicability.requiredCheck: Verify that the checkpoint carries no blocker while it claims to be ready for review.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A passing validation with blockedBy empty at a readiness status.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

title: A PASS requires evidence that can be executed or resolved, not a statement
symptom: A quality dimension was recorded as PASS in a checkpoint that contained no corresponding execution.
rootCauseSummary: Quality results were bare verdicts with no link to the run that produced them, so a verdict could be inherited from an earlier checkpoint without re-execution.
resolution: Every dimension records status, evidence and justification, and a PASS needs at least one reference that resolves to a successful command record or a non-empty file.

prevention.description: A PASS with no evidence is rejected.
A PASS pointing at a failed command is rejected.
_validate_quality_evidence resolves every reference.
A PASS without resolvable evidence is refused for every positive terminal status.
Every positive status is exercised against every mandatory red dimension.

applicability.requiredCheck: Attach a resolvable evidence reference to every PASS recorded by this Gate.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A validation run confirming that every PASS reference resolves.

title: The repository must be self-contained; a specification may not live outside it
symptom: The Master Plan accepted the Gate against a checklist that existed only in an external prompt file on one machine.
rootCauseSummary: The authoritative requirement was never committed, so completeness could not be verified from the repository alone even though the entry contract claimed the repository was the only source of truth.
resolution: The specification was written into docs/SETUP-00-CHECKLIST.md and the Master Plan and start protocol now reference it.

prevention.description: The in-repository specification exists and is referenced.
Every relative documentation link resolves.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every specification this Gate depends on is committed to the repository.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A passing documentation link and checklist test.

title: Independent validation cannot be declared by the run that did the work
symptom: The implementing run produced its own review and Red Team reports and the earlier checkpoint reached GATE_PASS on that basis.
rootCauseSummary: Cross-tool validation was a sentence in a document rather than structured state, so nothing prevented an implementer from certifying itself.
resolution: secondToolValidation is structured state, GATE_PASS requires it to be PASSED or a justified NOT_REQUIRED, and READY_FOR_REVIEW requires independentReview and redTeam to still be PENDING.

prevention.description: A failed cross-tool validation cannot promote a Gate.
An implementing run cannot record its own independent verdict.
The cross-tool and independent verdict states are enumerated, not free text.
An external verdict is derived from an attestation authored by another checkpoint.
A delivery that declares its own external PASS is refused.

applicability.requiredCheck: Close the implementing run at an internal status and leave the independent verdict pending.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A checkpoint whose independentReview and redTeam are PENDING at handoff.

guardrailFailures.detail: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: M0-F-002: an implementing run reached MILESTONE_EXTERNAL_PASS by filling secondToolValidation and milestone.status itself, with the independent review and the Red Team still pending (attacks Q, R, S).

title: Requirement completeness must be total and evidence-backed before handoff
symptom: The independent tool was spending its effort discovering unimplemented requirements and missing evidence rather than auditing design.
rootCauseSummary: No artifact held the complete requirement set, so completeness was a judgement made from memory of the conversation.
resolution: Requirements are extracted into REQUIREMENTS-MATRIX.json before implementation and audited by a validator that resolves every evidence reference and refuses anything short of total coverage.

prevention.description: Coverage below total fails the audit.
An unexecuted completeness audit blocks readiness.
Completeness is recomputed over an independently derived expected set.
Deleting a requirement and recomputing every count still fails.

applicability.requiredCheck: Extract every requirement before implementing and audit completeness before handoff.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A completeness report with total coverage and total evidence coverage.

guardrailFailures.detail: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: M0-F-006: deleting a mandatory requirement and recomputing every stored count produced a smaller denominator and a forged 100% completeness (attack C).

title: A red gate requires rework, never a waiver, and never a weakened check
symptom: Nothing structurally prevented a delivery from being offered while a mandatory gate was red.
rootCauseSummary: Greenness was a habit rather than a recorded, verified state, and no artifact tied a failure to the repair that resolved it.
resolution: The Green Keeper runs the mandatory gates, records every cycle with its root cause in REWORK-LOG.jsonl, and GREEN_KEEPER_GATE is PASS only when nothing is red and no rework item is unresolved.

prevention.description: A red gate is reported as still red and exits nonzero.
A PASS that contradicts the last cycle is rejected.
A failing quality dimension blocks readiness.
The mandatory gate set is closed by policy and cannot be narrowed by an invocation.
A cycle measured against no gate cannot produce a PASS.

applicability.requiredCheck: Run the Green Keeper until every mandatory gate is green, repairing causes rather than checks.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A rework log whose last cycle is GREEN with zero remaining failures.

guardrailFailures.detail: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: M0-F-005: green_keeper.py --gates "" exited zero and recorded GREEN_KEEPER_GATE=PASS with no gate executed and no evidence (attack V).

title: A recorded command must carry runtime, working directory, commit and purpose to be replayable

source.finding: R3 (SETUP-00-CP-0004 review, decomposed as R3.2 in SETUP-00-CP-0005)

symptom: Recorded finalizer commands named a bare script that does not exist in the working directory they declared, so the ledger could not be replayed.
rootCauseSummary: The record stored a convenient label rather than the literal invocation, and nothing checked that the label could be executed.
resolution: Records carry runtime, working directory, sanitized arguments, referenced inputs, repository commit, purpose and a canonical result, and validation rejects a command that does not start with an explicit runtime or whose script path does not resolve.

prevention.description: A bare script name is rejected.
A script path that does not resolve is rejected.
The reproducibility fields are part of the record contract.
A record that names an input must bind it by content hash.
A record without an input digest is refused.

applicability.requiredCheck: Record commands with the tooling so each one is executable from its declared working directory.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A validation run over a ledger whose commands all resolve.

guardrailFailures.detail: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: M0-F-009: sampled command records did not replay at their declared commits because dirty working-tree inputs were never bound by content.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

title: A control over a checkpoint's own evidence must be scoped to the moment it matters
symptom: The gate that validates the checkpoint kept failing because running it appends to the very ledger and inventory the validation binds.
rootCauseSummary: Consistency rules written for a finished delivery were applied while the delivery was still writing its own evidence, which no ordering of steps can satisfy.
resolution: Gate consistency is enforced when the delivery is offered for review and treated as provisional while work is in progress, and the harness re-derives declared hashes immediately before validating.

prevention.description: Provisional in progress, strict at handoff.
Declared hashes are re-derived before the validation gate runs, never invented.

applicability.requiredCheck: Check whether any new control would be invalidated by the evidence its own run produces.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A passing validation executed by the gate harness itself.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

title: Sealed checkpoints and their tags are immutable, and tooling must keep validating them
symptom: Every correction cycle created pressure to edit or retag an earlier checkpoint so the new rules would fit it.
rootCauseSummary: Control-plane rules evolve while history does not, so without version dispatch a new rule silently invalidates sealed evidence.
resolution: Checkpoints declare a schema version, validation applies the rules of the declared version, and a regression validates clean clones detached at every sealed tag.

prevention.description: The first sealed checkpoint still validates.
The most recent sealed review checkpoint still validates.
Schema versions and immutability are stated in the protocol.
The sealed chain of tags, commits and trees is re-derived from Git.
A moved historical tag is detected.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every sealed checkpoint still validates under the tooling this Gate changes.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A passing historical compatibility run over every sealed tag.

guardrailFailures.detail: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: M0-F-007: moving a checkpoint tag together with HEAD, and rewriting a sealed predecessor with refreshed dependent hashes, both validated (attacks I, J).

title: An installed capability must be detected by resolved path, not by a bare command lookup
symptom: A checkpoint recorded that a tool was not installed because a bare command lookup failed, when the tool was installed outside the detecting process PATH.
rootCauseSummary: Absence was inferred from one lookup mechanism rather than from a search of resolved locations, so a configuration detail was recorded as a capability fact.
resolution: Capability records name the resolved executable path and the version it reported, and a failed bare lookup is recorded as a PATH observation rather than as absence.

prevention.description: Detected capabilities are recorded with resolved paths and the PATH caveat.

applicability.requiredCheck: When this Gate records a capability, resolve the executable path before concluding anything about availability.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A capability record naming the resolved path, or a justification that this Gate detects no capability.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

notes: Not guarded: no automated control can observe an arbitrary machine's installation state from this repository.

title: Evidence must be recorded as it happens, not reconstructed at the end of a run
symptom: Part of a command ledger was written after the fact because the recorder was introduced mid-run, so timestamps were recording times rather than execution times.
rootCauseSummary: The ledger was treated as a report produced at the end instead of an instrument used during the work.
resolution: Commands are recorded through the tooling as they run, and any record written after the fact states that its timestamp is a recording time.

prevention.description: Recording a command captures its real timing and repository state at execution.
Sealing is monotonic and its final evidence describes the sealed commit.
A ledger record later than the recorded end of the run is refused.

applicability.requiredCheck: Record each command through the tooling while the work happens.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A ledger whose records were produced by the recording tooling during the run.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

notes: Residual limit of the control: the guardrail verifies that execution evidence was recorded through the tooling and bound to the repository state at validation time. It cannot prove from the artifact alone that an observer witnessed the command at the instant it ran.

title: Every positive terminal status needs one shared promotion invariant
symptom: A checkpoint mutated to MILESTONE_EXTERNAL_PASS with greenKeeper.status=FAIL produced no validation error, because the strong promotion checks were written only for READY_FOR_REVIEW.
rootCauseSummary: The promotion rules were attached to one status rather than to the concept of a positive terminal status, so each new status silently started with no rules.
resolution: One invariant is evaluated for every positive terminal status, and each status adds requirements on top of it instead of replacing it.

prevention.description: One promotion invariant is evaluated for every positive terminal status.
Every positive status refuses a red Green Keeper gate.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every positive terminal status this Gate can produce is covered by the shared promotion invariant, not only the status this delivery ends at.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A table-driven validation run that exercises every positive status against every mandatory red dimension.

notes: Reproduced by the independent M0 audit of SETUP-00-CP-0006 and corrected in SETUP-00-CP-0008.

title: A mandatory set must be closed by policy, never chosen by the caller
symptom: green_keeper.py --gates "" exited zero and wrote GREEN_KEEPER_GATE=PASS with an empty command list, and checkpoint validation accepted it next to a failing test.
rootCauseSummary: The tool asked its caller which gates were mandatory. A control whose scope is an argument can always be reduced to nothing.
resolution: The mandatory gate set is read from a machine-readable policy registry. An invocation may extend a run; it can no longer shrink the mandatory set.

prevention.description: A GREEN cycle must have executed exactly the canonical mandatory set.
The mandatory set is a registry, not an argument.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every control whose scope could be narrowed by an argument derives that scope from policy instead.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A recorded gate run whose requiredGates equal the canonical mandatory set, with a successful command for each one.

title: A completeness denominator must come from a source the delivery does not own
symptom: Deleting a mandatory requirement and recomputing every stored count left the matrix at 46 of 46, and both the completeness audit and checkpoint validation passed.
rootCauseSummary: Coverage was computed over the submitted set, so the submitted set decided what total coverage meant.
resolution: The expected identifier set is derived from the canonical Gate specification, the lesson preflight and the open audit findings, and is compared with the declared set exactly.

prevention.description: The expected identifier set is derived from the canonical sources and compared exactly.
An anchored requirement outside the expected set is refused.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that the expected requirement set is derived independently and compared as a set, not only as a count.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A completeness report whose expected and declared identifier sets are equal.

title: A structured reference must be resolved, not merely well typed
symptom: A GUARDED lesson naming a nonexistent test, a lesson citing a nonexistent evidence file, and a secret-shaped value nested in prevention.description all validated.
rootCauseSummary: Validation checked that a field had the right shape and never asked the repository whether the thing it named exists.
resolution: Every control reference, evidence path and derived artifact is resolved against the repository and the discovered test suite, and the whole object is scanned for secrets at any depth.

prevention.description: Every control reference is resolved against the suite or the repository.
A control naming a nonexistent test is refused.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every reference this Gate records is resolved by a tool, not accepted as a string.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a nonexistent control, a nonexistent evidence path and a nested secret.

title: A derived artifact must carry a fingerprint of the inputs that produced it
symptom: Retiring a canonical lesson left the stale active preflight in place, and both the memory and the checkpoint still validated; a GATE 1 state also reused a SETUP-00 preflight.
rootCauseSummary: Freshness was judged by comparing the artifact with the state that stored its own counts, and by a timestamp, instead of by recomputing it from its inputs.
resolution: The preflight records a content fingerprint of the memory, the guardrail registry, the lesson schema, the selection policy and the Gate inputs, and validation recomputes both the fingerprint and the selection.

prevention.description: A derived artifact is recomputed, and a changed input makes it stale.
Retiring or dropping a lesson makes an existing preflight stale.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every derived artifact this Gate stores can be recomputed and is recomputed during validation.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a preflight whose inputs have changed.

title: Evidence produced from a dirty tree needs immutable input identity
symptom: Sampled commands replayed at the sealed tag but failed at their own declared commits, and a run claimed to finish three seconds before the finalizer that sealed it ran.
rootCauseSummary: A record named a commit while its real inputs lived only in an uncommitted working tree, and the sealing order let the recorded chronology contradict itself.
resolution: Every record binds its declared inputs by content hash, and sealing is a monotonic post-commit workflow whose final validation is recorded against a clean tree at the sealed content commit.

prevention.description: Every declared input is bound by content hash at execution time.
The recorder binds inputs without being asked.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every recorded command binds its inputs by content and that no timestamp in the ledger is later than the recorded end of the run.

title: Sealed history needs an anchor outside the content it describes
symptom: Moving a checkpoint tag together with HEAD validated, and rewriting a sealed predecessor while refreshing the dependent hashes also validated.
rootCauseSummary: Every expected value lived inside the mutable checkpoint content, so a coordinated edit left nothing to contradict.
resolution: A hash-linked anchor chain records the tag, commit and tree of every sealed checkpoint in an earlier commit than the objects it anchors, and validation re-derives all of it from Git.

prevention.description: The anchored tag, commit and tree of every sealed checkpoint are re-derived from Git.
A broken link between two anchors is detected.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that the integrity chain still resolves for every sealed checkpoint and that this Gate anchors every sealed predecessor.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A verification run over the anchor chain returning no divergence.

title: An authoritative count must be derived once, never maintained by hand twice
symptom: The sealed CP-0006 state declared 47 mandatory requirements while the matrix and the completeness report both computed 45, and validation never compared them.
rootCauseSummary: The same number was written by hand in several artifacts, so the artifacts could disagree without any tool noticing.
resolution: Counts used as evidence are derived into one machine-readable artifact, cross-checked against state and report aggregates, and verified wherever a report states them.

prevention.description: Counts used as evidence are derived once and verified wherever they are stated.
A report that states a count contradicting the derivation is refused.
No comment or docstring in scripts/ or tests/ states a derived count.
A count stated in a source comment or docstring is not evidence.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every count used as evidence in this Gate is derived from one source and verified where it is quoted.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A validation run that rejects a report whose stated count contradicts the derived one.

symptom: LSN-0007 attributed findings R4 and R7 to SETUP-00-CP-0003, but R7 is recorded in the SETUP-00-CP-0004 review.
rootCauseSummary: Provenance was written from recollection of where a finding had been discussed, and nothing resolved the citation against the cited checkpoint.
resolution: Lesson provenance is resolved: the cited checkpoint must exist and the cited finding identifier must appear in that checkpoint's own recorded evidence.

prevention.description: A lesson's cited checkpoint must record the finding identifier it names.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every lesson this Gate writes or updates cites a checkpoint that records the finding identifier it names.

title: A control is finished only when its positive path has been executed, not only its refusals
symptom: The milestone attestation refused fifteen forged variants and could accept nothing, because the attestation had to live inside the tree of the commit it named as its subject, so the status it guarded was unreachable.
rootCauseSummary: The control was exercised only from the refusing side. Twelve rejection tests passed while the reachable state space was empty, so nothing failed when the positive path disappeared.
resolution: The verdict moved to the audit checkpoint, which names an already sealed subject, and the positive promotion is now executed end to end in a disposable repository by promotion_simulation.py and asserted by PositivePromotionTests.

prevention.description: A legitimate two-checkpoint promotion reaches a derived milestone PASS.
The positive promotion is executed and recorded as a delivery artifact.
The artifact a simulation seals is bound by content to the tool's own output.

applicability.requiredCheck: For every control this Gate adds or changes that gates a status, execute the path that reaches the status, not only the paths that are refused.
applicability.requiredEvidence: An executed positive-path test or simulation artifact for each such control.

notes: Reopened by CP11-F-001 and repaired in SETUP-00-CP-0012, which made the simulation execute m0_mirror_audit.py and bound the sealed artifact to the tool's own output by content. title: A generic guardrail derives repository state instead of naming today's checkpoint
symptom: A chain guardrail test excluded a checkpoint by literal name while the product derived the same exclusion from repository state, so anchoring the sealed predecessor turned the mandatory tests gate red.
rootCauseSummary: The same semantic rule was implemented twice, once derived and once typed, and the typed copy encoded the repository as it looked on the day it was written.
resolution: The rule has one implementation, anchors.pending_anchor_exclusion, which the CLI, the validator and the suite all call, and a succession simulation proves it keeps moving.

prevention.description: The checkpoint whose anchor is still owed is derived from history.
The exclusion follows the chain across successive checkpoints.
The exclusion equals the newest sealed checkpoint, never a literal.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that no generic guard, test or policy in this Gate names a historical checkpoint to decide behaviour, and that any such rule is derived from repository state.

title: An adversarial battery without a null-mutation control proves nothing
symptom: An attack harness reported every attack as defended while the refusals came from leftover state and a broken seal chronology rather than from the mutation under test.
rootCauseSummary: The harness never ran an unmutated case through the identical path, so a fixture that refused everything was indistinguishable from a control that worked.
resolution: The battery records a baselineControl, the unmutated fixture run through the same path, and validation refuses a report whose control is missing or not VALID.

prevention.description: A Red Team report must carry its null-mutation control.
A battery whose control is missing or INVALID cannot produce a PASS.
A report without the control is refused.

applicability.requiredCheck: Run every adversarial battery of this Gate with an unmutated control through the same path, and record its result with the battery.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A Red Team report whose baselineControl is VALID.

symptom: A GUARDED lesson carried a note saying it was not guarded, so a reader who trusted the prose reached the opposite conclusion from the machine-readable status.
rootCauseSummary: The note was written while the lesson was unguarded and was never revisited when an automated control was added, because nothing compared the two.
resolution: Memory validation refuses a GUARDED lesson whose notes assert that it is not guarded, and the note now describes the residual limit of the control instead of its status.

prevention.description: A GUARDED lesson may not describe itself as unguarded.
The contradiction is refused by the memory validator.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every lesson this Gate writes or updates describes limits rather than restating its own status.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A memory validation run with no status contradiction reported.

title: A configuration key that no code reads is a defect, not documentation
symptom: The memory policy declared a relocatable guardrail registry path while the implementation resolved a fixed constant, so re-pointing the documented key changed nothing.
rootCauseSummary: The policy document was never validated against a schema, so a key could be added without any consumer and without any check noticing.
resolution: The unread key was removed, the fixed path is documented and resolved by one function, and the policy document is validated against a closed schema that refuses an unknown key.

prevention.description: The memory policy schema is closed to keys no code reads.
The declared policy is validated like every other governing document.
Declaring an unread setting is a validation error.

applicability.requiredCheck: Confirm that every configuration key this Gate declares is read by the implementation, or remove it and document the fixed behaviour.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A validated policy document whose every key has a consumer.

title: A required protocol transition must never turn a mandatory gate red
symptom: Carrying out a step the checkpoint protocol requires of every successor, anchoring its sealed predecessor, took the mandatory suite from green to red and left editing a guardrail test as the only apparent remedy.
rootCauseSummary: The controls were written against one repository state instead of against the sequence of states the protocol itself produces.
resolution: The successor durability simulation seals a chain of checkpoints and re-runs the controls at every state, so a transition that breaks a gate is found by the delivery that introduces it rather than by the next audit.

prevention.description: The protocol's own next steps are executed and the gates re-checked.
Every state of an advancing chain keeps the controls green.
The transition into the first delivery of the next Gate is executed before handoff.

applicability.requiredCheck: Before handoff, execute the protocol transitions this Gate's successor will perform and confirm the mandatory gates stay green.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A successor durability artifact whose every state is green.

guardrailFailures.detail: GUARDRAIL_FAILURE: successor_durability.py covers the succession of checkpoints inside one Gate and not the transition into the next Gate, so the first delivery of any later Gate still could not reach READY_FOR_REVIEW (CP11-F-001).

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

notes: Reopened by CP11-F-001 and repaired in SETUP-00-CP-0012, which added the Gate transition simulation. The residual limit is that the next Gate's specification in that simulation is synthetic and lives only in the disposable repository, so the simulation proves the state machine and never the content of a later Gate.

title: The lesson preflight presumes an implementing delivery and constrains an audit run badly
symptom: Requirements derived for an implementing delivery, such as an empty blockedBy at a readiness status, cannot apply to an audit checkpoint that legitimately records blockers.
rootCauseSummary: The preflight has one role model, so a run that audits rather than implements would have to answer requirements that do not describe it.
resolution: Recorded as a scoped lesson that constrains audit runs only, so an implementing Gate is not asked to answer it, until a delivery-role input is worth building.

prevention.description: The preflight's role assumption is recorded rather than implied.

applicability.requiredCheck: When this run audits rather than implements, record which derived requirements describe the audit role and which describe an implementing delivery.
applicability.requiredEvidence: A preflight whose scope names the audit role, or a recorded justification.

provenance.notes: Derived from sealed checkpoint findings; no content outside this repository was used.

notes: Scoped to audit runs. No automated control exists yet, and the lesson is deliberately not GUARDED: documentation alone never earns that status.

title: An empty applicable set is not a missing required set, and a control must tell them apart
symptom: The internal mirror audit required its derived set to be non-empty in order to report success, so a delivery that legitimately had no audit to correct was refused for having nothing to correct, and checkpoint validation then refused every positive terminal status.
rootCauseSummary: The check conflated two states of a derived set. Zero items derived because nothing of this kind applies was treated as zero items derived because the delivery failed to supply them.
resolution: A dimension whose canonically derived applicable set is empty is NOT_APPLICABLE with a reason, an expected count of zero and the source the emptiness was derived from; a dimension whose sources name items the delivery does not satisfy stays FAIL. The applicable set is derived from the canonical sources at every call, so no delivery can declare its own set empty.

prevention.description: Every applicability state is executed through the real tool, including the negatives.
A delivery with nothing to audit reaches a passing mirror.
A dimension the canonical sources make applicable cannot be declared inapplicable.
Checkpoint validation re-derives the applicable set instead of believing the report.

applicability.requiredCheck: For every quality or audit control this Gate adds or changes that operates on a derived set, confirm that an empty applicable set is reported as NOT_APPLICABLE with a justification and that a missing required set is reported as a failure.
applicability.requiredEvidence: An executed artifact showing both outcomes: a passing run whose empty dimensions are justified, and a failing run whose named items are unsatisfied.

provenance.notes: Derived from the recorded fresh-session M0 audit of SETUP-00-CP-0010; no chain-of-thought stored.

notes: The residual limit is that the distinction is enforced where the applicable set has a canonical source the validator can re-derive; a dimension whose emptiness cannot be re-derived is justified by the auditor and not cross-checked.
